items.text: It's a story about the love between a father and his son.
For years, the father served as the postman for this area.
He was often absent from home and the son seldom saw him.
Now the son is taking over his father’s position.
The father goes with him on his first day of work.
Along the way, they start to see into each other’s hearts.
For the first time, the son carries his father across a cold river.
It brings back the father’s memory of carrying the son on his back.
His love may be silent. But like a mountain, it is always there.
Postmen in the Mountains tells a touching story about love between a father and his son.
The father works as a postman in the mountains and is often absent from home.
When the father grows old, his son takes over his job.
On the son’s first trip, the father goes with him.
At a cold river, the son carries his father on his back.
This reminds the father of carrying his little boy years ago.
The father seldom speaks about his love, but his actions show it.
His love is silent, strong and always there, like a mountain.
Postmen in the Mountains shows the silent love between a father and his son.
On a quiet mountain road, the son begins his first journey as a postman, with his father walking behind him.
For many years, the father worked as a postman in this area.
His job often kept him away from home, so the son seldom saw him and did not know him very well.
Now the son is taking over his father’s job.
As they deliver letters along the mountain road, they spend more time together and slowly begin to understand each other better.
When they reach a cold river, the son carries his father across on his back.
This reminds the father of carrying his little son many years ago.
He suddenly sees that his boy has grown into a strong young man, and tears come into his eyes.
The father seldom shows his love with words, hugs or kisses.
His love is silent, but it is always there, strong and steady like a mountain.
We all know about “problem teenagers”.
But do you know that some teenagers have “problem parents”?
So, today we are going to talk about these “problem parents”.
For example, Tina’s mother is an actress at a park.
Every day, she dresses up as a queen.
Cool, right?
But Tina doesn’t think so.
Her mother often goes to pick her up in this dress.
Tina is not happy about it.
It is always a good idea for Tina to have a good talk with her mother.
They are always close to each other.
Robert has a serious disease and cannot move at all.
He has to stay at home every day and he often feels lonely.
John sees Robert’s sad face and wants to help.
One day, he finds a way.
He puts Robert in a trailer and pulls it along with his bike.
A big, bright smile appears on Robert’s face.
It is hard for John to pull Robert’s trailer. But John refuses to race without his brother.
But for the brothers, some things are more important than winning.
“I feel happy because I can race with my brother,” Robert says.
John and Robert Taylor are close brothers.
Robert has a serious illness and cannot move by himself, so he often stays at home and feels lonely.
John wants to help his brother play like other children.
He puts Robert in a special trailer and pulls it with his bike.
Soon, they begin to take part in bike races together.
Pulling the trailer is difficult, but John never leaves Robert behind.
He refuses to race without his brother.
They may not always win, but that is not important to them.
For the brothers, the love between them powers their bike.
While other children play outside, Robert Taylor has to stay at home.
He has a serious disease and cannot move at all.
Robert sometimes feels lonely and hopes to join the other kids.
His brother John notices Robert’s sad face and thinks about how to help.
One day, he finds a way.
He puts Robert in a trailer and pulls it along with his bike.
During their first race, a big, bright smile appears on Robert’s face.
For the first time, he feels like the other kids.
That first race becomes the start of many more races.
Pulling Robert’s trailer is hard for John, but he refuses to race without his brother.
They do not often win, yet they enjoy every race and the time together.
For John and Robert, the result is not the most important thing.
The love between them powers their bike.
In their story, love always wins.
